# PDFLokal

> Free PDF tools that run entirely in the browser: edit, sign, merge, split, and compress PDFs without uploading the file to any server. Made in Indonesia.

PDF and image files are processed on the user's own device and are never uploaded. Free, no account, no watermark. After one visit the site also installs as an app (PWA) and can open, edit, and download PDFs offline.

The tool pages at the root are written in Indonesian. The main page is also available in English at /en, and a browser whose first language is English is sent there from /. The editor is the same in both languages.

## Tools

- [Edit PDF](https://www.pdflokal.id/edit-pdf): add text, cover existing text, and change text already printed in a PDF (beta), including scans through OCR that runs in the browser
- [Tanda Tangan PDF](https://www.pdflokal.id/tanda-tangan-pdf): sign a PDF by drawing with a finger or by using a photo of a signature
- [Gabung PDF](https://www.pdflokal.id/gabung-pdf): merge several PDFs into one
- [Pisah PDF](https://www.pdflokal.id/pisah-pdf): take chosen pages out into a new file
- [Hapus Halaman PDF](https://www.pdflokal.id/hapus-halaman-pdf): delete, reorder, or rotate pages
- [Kompres PDF](https://www.pdflokal.id/kompres-pdf): reduce PDF size, with target sizes of [100 KB](https://www.pdflokal.id/kompres-pdf-100kb), [200 KB](https://www.pdflokal.id/kompres-pdf-200kb), [500 KB](https://www.pdflokal.id/kompres-pdf-500kb), and [1 MB](https://www.pdflokal.id/kompres-pdf-1mb)
- [JPG ke PDF](https://www.pdflokal.id/jpg-ke-pdf): turn photos or scans into one PDF
- [PDF ke JPG](https://www.pdflokal.id/pdf-ke-jpg): turn PDF pages into JPG or PNG images

## English

- [PDFLokal in English](https://www.pdflokal.id/en): the same editor as the main page, in English

## Privacy

- [Kebijakan Privasi](https://www.pdflokal.id/privasi): what stays on the device and what is sent (analytics, session recording, error reports, feedback); in Indonesian

- [Dukung PDFLokal](https://www.pdflokal.id/dukung): about the maker, Fauzan Ahladzikri (Ojan), and how to support the project, in Indonesian
- [Support PDFLokal](https://www.pdflokal.id/en/support): the same page in English
